errors.text: The predicted effect has the wrong sign: the generated hypothesis predicts a 10–20% conductivity reduction, whereas the target reports an approximately 12% increase.

The central mechanism is reversed. The target attributes enhancement to reduced lattice distortion and percolating HfTi/TiZr ordered pathways, while the generated hypothesis asserts that SRO amplifies distortion and adds phonon scattering.
The proposed evidence concerns general HEA disorder, electrical transport, or dislocation mechanics and does not validate the claimed SRO-induced suppression of lattice thermal conductivity.
The experiment measures bulk thermal conductivity without a sufficiently specified separation of electronic and lattice contributions, which is essential in metallic refractory alloys.
